_comment: "Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack / If there is a card with cost 3 or greater in your pitch zone, Titan's Fist has +1{p}." SOURCE_IS_ATTACK matters here even though the clause says 'Titan's Fist HAS +1{p}' rather than 'its attacks get': the weapon sits equipped for the whole game, so an ungated MODIFY_ATTACK would pump every attack its controller makes, not just this weapon's. Unlike the keyword cards the gate has no effect on printed keywords -- this card has none -- so it is here purely to scope the pump. Activation cost is left to the printed-text parse, which reads {r}{r}{r} as 3. Corpus: 2981 attacks, previously all skipped as unimplemented.
